blocks.html: BMW timing chain failure is one of the most serious mechanical issues affecting modern BMW diesel and petrol engines. Our workshop carries out full diagnostic assessment, strip-down inspection, and complete timing chain replacement using OEM-spec components.

For engines with the timing chain mounted at the rear (such as the N47 diesel), the repair requires full engine removal. For front-mounted chains (N20, N55, B58), access is less complex but still requires specialist tools and precise timing verification. Every repair includes replacement of the timing chain, guides, tensioners, and all associated seals and gaskets.
We test every engine after reassembly to confirm correct timing and operation before the vehicle is returned.
Final cost depends on the engine type, extent of wear, and whether the chain has already failed. We provide a fixed-price quote after full inspection.
Timing chain issues affect a range of BMW engines. We carry out full timing chain replacement on the following models and engine families.
Timing chain issues are most prevalent on N47 diesel engines (2007-2015) and N20 petrol engines. [Read our full N47 buying guide →](/guides)

steps.title: Diagnostic assessment
steps.body: We use BMW-specific diagnostic equipment to check for timing-related fault codes and perform a cold-start inspection to identify characteristic rattle.

steps.title: Strip-down inspection
steps.body: Where required, we partially or fully disassemble the engine to visually inspect the chain, guides, tensioner and sprockets for wear or damage.

steps.title: Engine removal (if required)
steps.body: For rear-mounted chains (N47), we remove the engine from the vehicle to gain full access to the timing chain cover.

steps.title: Chain and component replacement
steps.body: We replace the timing chain, all guides, tensioners, sprockets, and seals with OEM-spec components.

steps.title: Timing verification
steps.body: Specialist timing tools are used to lock the camshafts and crankshaft in the correct position before reassembly.

steps.title: Testing & road test
steps.body: The engine is tested for correct timing and operation, followed by a road test before the vehicle is returned.

items.q: What are the early signs of BMW timing chain failure?
items.a: The most common early symptom is a metallic rattling noise during cold starts, which typically lasts a few seconds until oil pressure builds. Other signs include rough idle, misfires, loss of power, and a check engine light with cam/crank correlation faults.

items.q: Which BMW engines are most prone to timing chain issues?
items.a: The N47 diesel (2.0L, 2007-2015) is the most notorious, with the chain mounted at the rear of the engine. The N20 petrol (2.0L turbo, 2011-2016) also suffers from timing chain stretch. Other affected engines include N57 (diesel I6) and B47 (later diesel).

items.q: Do you remove the engine for timing chain replacement?
items.a: For N47 engines, yes - the chain is mounted at the rear of the engine and cannot be accessed without full engine removal. For front-mounted chains (N20, N55, B58), the engine stays in place but the front end is stripped for access.

items.q: How long does a BMW timing chain replacement take?
items.a: For an N47 engine-out job, the repair typically takes 30-35 hours of workshop time. Front-mounted chain replacements are quicker, typically 12-16 hours. We provide a timeline estimate during the quoting process.

items.q: What is included in your timing chain repair?
items.a: We replace the timing chain, all guides, tensioners, sprockets, and associated seals and gaskets with OEM-spec components. The repair includes full timing verification, engine testing, and a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

items.q: Can I drive my BMW if the timing chain is rattling?
items.a: We don't recommend it. If the tensioner is failing or a guide is cracked, the chain can jump teeth or break completely, leading to catastrophic engine damage. Have it inspected as soon as possible.
